* SELECTION-SCREEN BEGIN OF BLOCK CHECK  WITH FRAME TITLE TEXT-102.    *
SELECTION-SCREEN SKIP 1.
SELECTION-SCREEN COMMENT /1(79) text-102       MODIF ID ia.
PARAMETER: vor   LIKE rv12l-vor  DEFAULT 'X'   MODIF ID ia,
           nach  LIKE rv12l-nach DEFAULT 'X'   MODIF ID ia.
* SELECTION-SCREEN END OF BLOCK CHECK.                                 *
SELECTION-SCREEN END OF BLOCK datum.
PARAMETERS p_dat  LIKE rv130-datam DEFAULT sy-datlo MODIF ID kn.
PARAMETER date_as TYPE date_as MODIF ID das.


*--------- options                                                     *
SELECTION-SCREEN SKIP 1.
SELECTION-SCREEN BEGIN OF BLOCK option WITH FRAME TITLE text-000.
PARAMETERS:
 par_staf  TYPE kostaff DEFAULT  '' MODIF ID nb,  " scale
 par_dat   TYPE koguelt DEFAULT  'X' MODIF ID nb,  " time
 par_pos   TYPE kokonpf DEFAULT  '' MODIF ID nb, " KONP fields
 par_l     TYPE kodelfl DEFAULT  'X' MODIF ID nb, " Show Dele
 par_excl  TYPE koexcl  DEFAULT  '' MODIF ID nb. "EXclusiv

PARAMETERS sen_idoc(1) TYPE c NO-DISPLAY.
PARAMETERS getknumh(1) TYPE c NO-DISPLAY.
PARAMETERS p_delete(1) TYPE c NO-DISPLAY.
PARAMETERS p_mestyp  LIKE tbdme-mestyp  NO-DISPLAY.
PARAMETERS p_logsys  LIKE tbdls-logsys  NO-DISPLAY.
PARAMETERS p_print   AS CHECKBOX  MODIF ID na.
SELECTION-SCREEN END OF BLOCK option.

SELECTION-SCREEN SKIP 1.
PARAMETERS:  max_line LIKE rv10a-maxline
                  DEFAULT 500.

DATA oldknumh TYPE c.
DATA counter TYPE i.


*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*   AT SELECTION-SCREEN                                                *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
AT SELECTION-SCREEN.
  "Selektionsdatum ins Memory schicken
  SET PARAMETER ID '1)9' FIELD p_dat.
  getknumh = oldknumh.

  IMPORT t180-aktyp FROM MEMORY ID 'RV_COND_MEMORY_02'.

  LOOP AT SCREEN.
    IF ( sen_idoc IS INITIAL OR getknumh IS INITIAL )
                             AND screen-group1 = 'NA'.
      screen-invisible = '1'.
      screen-active    = '0'.
      p_print = 'X'.
    ENDIF.
    IF getknumh IS INITIAL AND screen-group1 = 'KN'. " Gültig am
      screen-invisible = '1'.
      screen-active    = '0'.
      p_print = 'X'.
    ENDIF.
    IF NOT getknumh IS INITIAL AND screen-group1 = 'KN'. " Gültig am
      screen-required = '1'.
    ENDIF.
    IF getknumh IS INITIAL AND screen-group1 = 'DAS'. "Gültig beibehal
      screen-invisible = '1'.
      screen-active    = '0'.
      p_print = 'X'.
    ENDIF.
    IF getknumh NE space AND screen-group1 = 'DAS' AND
                       t180-aktyp NE 'X'.
      screen-invisible = '1'.
      screen-active    = '0'.
      p_print = 'X'.
    ENDIF.
    IF NOT getknumh IS INITIAL AND screen-group1 = 'NB'. " Schalter
      screen-invisible = '1'.
    ENDIF.
    IF ( sen_idoc NE space OR getknumh NE space )
                        AND screen-group1 = 'IA'.  " Zeitintervall
      screen-invisible = '1'.
      screen-active    = '0'.
      p_print = 'X'.
    ENDIF.
    MODIFY SCREEN.
  ENDLOOP.


*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*   AT SELECTION-SCREEN OUTPUT                                         *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
AT SELECTION-SCREEN OUTPUT.

  IF counter IS INITIAL.
    oldknumh = getknumh.
    ADD 1 TO counter.
  ENDIF.
  getknumh = oldknumh.

  IMPORT t180-aktyp FROM MEMORY ID 'RV_COND_MEMORY_02'.

  LOOP AT SCREEN.
    IF ( sen_idoc IS INITIAL OR getknumh IS INITIAL )
                             AND screen-group1 = 'NA'.
      screen-invisible = '1'.
      screen-active    = '0'.
      p_print = 'X'.
    ENDIF.
    IF getknumh IS INITIAL AND screen-group1 = 'KN'. " Gültig am
      screen-invisible = '1'.
      screen-active    = '0'.
      p_print = 'X'.
    ENDIF.
    IF NOT getknumh IS INITIAL AND screen-group1 = 'KN'. " Gültig am
      screen-required = '1'.
    ENDIF.
    IF getknumh IS INITIAL AND screen-group1 = 'DAS'. "Gültig beibehal
      screen-invisible = '1'.
      screen-active    = '0'.
      p_print = 'X'.
    ENDIF.
    IF getknumh NE space AND screen-group1 = 'DAS' AND
                       t180-aktyp NE 'X'.
      screen-invisible = '1'.
      screen-active    = '0'.
      p_print = 'X'.
    ENDIF.
    IF NOT getknumh IS INITIAL AND screen-group1 = 'NB'. " Schalter
      screen-invisible = '1'.
    ENDIF.
    IF ( sen_idoc NE space OR getknumh NE space )
                        AND screen-group1 = 'IA'.  " Zeitintervall
      screen-invisible = '1'.
      screen-active    = '0'.
      p_print = 'X'.
    ENDIF.
    MODIFY SCREEN.
  ENDLOOP.


*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*   START-OF-SELECTION                                                 *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
START-OF-SELECTION.


  PERFORM generierung_pruefen(rv14alle) USING 'A' 'V'
                                    'A1' '/1SDBF12L/RV14AKA1' 'X'.


*------  Einschränkung des SELECT-OPTIONS Gültigkeitszeitraum ------*  *
  DATA   datlow   LIKE   vake-datab.
  DATA   dathigh  LIKE   vake-datbi.
  datlow = datum-low.
  dathigh = datum-high.
  IF datlow IS INITIAL.
    datlow  = '00010101'.
    IF dathigh IS INITIAL.
      dathigh = '99991231'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
  IF NOT sen_idoc IS INITIAL.
    datlow  = '00010101'.
    dathigh ='99991231'.
  ENDIF.
  IF NOT getknumh IS INITIAL.
    datlow  = p_dat.
    dathigh = p_dat.
  ENDIF.

  IF NOT dathigh  IS INITIAL.
    CALL FUNCTION 'VALIDITY_PERIOD_CHECK'
      TABLES
        date            = datum
      EXCEPTIONS
        wrong_intervall = 01
        wrong_option    = 02
        wrong_sign      = 03.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      MESSAGE e106.
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.
    dathigh = datlow.
  ENDIF.

*------- Read Condition Tables into T_header_AXXX                      *
*package size for select statement                                     *
  DATA pack_size     TYPE   i.
  pack_size = max_line + 1.
* temporary variable to see no. of entries fetched                     *
  DATA ilines        LIKE   sy-tabix.

* Kschl fuer eine Tabelle                                              *
  DATA : BEGIN OF itab_kschl OCCURS 0.
          INCLUDE STRUCTURE t685.
  DATA: END OF itab_kschl.
  DATA    do_select TYPE c.                   " Exclusiv
*--------- read table   A635                                           *
  do_select = 'X'.
  IF NOT par_excl IS INITIAL.
    CLEAR ilines.
    IF ilines  EQ 0.
      DESCRIBE TABLE kschl LINES ilines.
    ENDIF.
    do_select = 'Y'.        " there are some non-obligatory fields
    IF ilines  EQ 0.
      DESCRIBE TABLE l_6 LINES ilines.
    ENDIF.
    do_select = 'Y'.        " there are some non-obligatory fields
    IF ilines  EQ 0.
      DESCRIBE TABLE l_2 LINES ilines.
    ENDIF.
    do_select = 'Y'.        " there are some non-obligatory fields
    IF ilines  EQ 0.
      DESCRIBE TABLE l_11 LINES ilines.
    ENDIF.
    do_select = 'Y'.        " there are some non-obligatory fields
    IF ilines EQ 0 AND do_select = 'Y'.
      CLEAR do_select.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
  IF NOT do_select IS INITIAL.
*----- read the conditiontypes of table  A635                          *
    CLEAR itab_kschl.
    REFRESH itab_kschl.
    CALL FUNCTION 'SD_GET_ALL_CONDTYPE_FROM_KOTAB'
      EXPORTING
        kvewe      = 'A'
        kappl      = 'V'
        kotabnr    = '635'
      TABLES
        kotab_t685 = itab_kschl.
    DESCRIBE TABLE itab_kschl LINES ilines.
    IF ilines GT 0.
      CLEAR t_header_a635.
      REFRESH t_header_a635.
      IF max_line IS INITIAL.
        IF vor IS INITIAL AND nach IS INITIAL.
          SELECT * FROM a635
                INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE t_header_a635
                FOR ALL ENTRIES IN itab_kschl
                WHERE  kschl EQ itab_kschl-kschl AND
                kschl IN kschl     AND
                pltyp IN l_6     AND
                vkorg IN l_17     AND
                matnr IN l_2     AND
                kfrst IN l_11     AND
                    datab >= datlow  AND  datbi <= dathigh AND
                kappl = 'V'.
        ELSEIF vor IS INITIAL.
          SELECT * FROM a635
                INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE t_header_a635
                FOR ALL ENTRIES IN itab_kschl
                WHERE  kschl EQ itab_kschl-kschl AND
                kschl IN kschl     AND
                pltyp IN l_6     AND
                vkorg IN l_17     AND
                matnr IN l_2     AND
                kfrst IN l_11     AND
                    datab >= datlow  AND  datab <= dathigh AND
                kappl = 'V'.

        ELSEIF nach IS INITIAL.
          SELECT * FROM a635
                INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE t_header_a635
                FOR ALL ENTRIES IN itab_kschl
                WHERE  kschl EQ itab_kschl-kschl AND
                kschl IN kschl     AND
                pltyp IN l_6     AND
                vkorg IN l_17     AND
                matnr IN l_2     AND
                kfrst IN l_11     AND
                  datbi <= dathigh  AND  datbi >= datlow AND
                kappl = 'V'.

        ELSE.
          SELECT * FROM a635
                INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE t_header_a635
                FOR ALL ENTRIES IN itab_kschl
                WHERE  kschl EQ itab_kschl-kschl AND
                kschl IN kschl     AND
                pltyp IN l_6     AND
                vkorg IN l_17     AND
                matnr IN l_2     AND
                kfrst IN l_11     AND
               (  ( datab >= datlow  AND  datbi <= dathigh ) OR
                  ( datab <= datlow AND datbi >= datlow  ) OR
                  ( datab <= dathigh AND datbi >= dathigh )  )  AND
                kappl = 'V'.

        ENDIF.

      ELSE.

        IF vor IS INITIAL AND nach IS INITIAL.
          SELECT * FROM a635
                INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE t_header_a635
                PACKAGE SIZE pack_size
                FOR ALL ENTRIES IN itab_kschl
                WHERE  kschl EQ itab_kschl-kschl AND
                kschl IN kschl     AND
                pltyp IN l_6     AND
                vkorg IN l_17     AND
                matnr IN l_2     AND
                kfrst IN l_11     AND
                    datab >= datlow  AND  datbi <= dathigh AND
                kappl = 'V'.
            DESCRIBE TABLE t_header_a635 LINES ilines.
            IF ilines > max_line.
              MESSAGE s016(es) WITH max_line.
" *****Code Remediation changes S4 2025_S Conversion **begin of change by EJX9007360 2026.06.09 ATC
*           DELETE t_header_a635 INDEX ilines.
            DELETE t_header_a635 INDEX ilines. "#EC CI_NOORDER
" *****Code Remediation changes S4 2025_S Conversion **end of change by EJX9007360 2026.06.09 ATC
            ENDIF.
" *****Code Remediation changes S4 2025_S Conversion **begin of change by EJX9007360 2026.06.09 ATC
*           EXIT.
            EXIT. "#EC CI_NOORDER
" *****Code Remediation changes S4 2025_S Conversion **end of change by EJX9007360 2026.06.09 ATC
          ENDSELECT.
        ELSEIF vor IS INITIAL.
          SELECT * FROM a635
                INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE t_header_a635
                PACKAGE SIZE pack_size
                FOR ALL ENTRIES IN itab_kschl
                WHERE  kschl EQ itab_kschl-kschl AND
                kschl IN kschl     AND
                pltyp IN l_6     AND
                vkorg IN l_17     AND
                matnr IN l_2     AND
                kfrst IN l_11     AND
                    datab >= datlow  AND  datab <= dathigh AND
                kappl = 'V'.
            DESCRIBE TABLE t_header_a635 LINES ilines.
            IF ilines > max_line.
              MESSAGE s016(es) WITH max_line.
" *****Code Remediation changes S4 2025_S Conversion **begin of change by EJX9007360 2026.06.09 ATC
*           DELETE t_header_a635 INDEX ilines.
            DELETE t_header_a635 INDEX ilines. "#EC CI_NOORDER
" *****Code Remediation changes S4 2025_S Conversion **end of change by EJX9007360 2026.06.09 ATC
            ENDIF.
" *****Code Remediation changes S4 2025_S Conversion **begin of change by EJX9007360 2026.06.09 ATC
*           EXIT.
            EXIT. "#EC CI_NOORDER
" *****Code Remediation changes S4 2025_S Conversion **end of change by EJX9007360 2026.06.09 ATC
          ENDSELECT.
        ELSEIF nach IS INITIAL.
          SELECT * FROM a635
                INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE t_header_a635
                PACKAGE SIZE pack_size
                FOR ALL ENTRIES IN itab_kschl
                WHERE  kschl EQ itab_kschl-kschl AND
                kschl IN kschl     AND
                pltyp IN l_6     AND
                vkorg IN l_17     AND
                matnr IN l_2     AND
                kfrst IN l_11     AND
                  datbi <= dathigh  AND  datbi >= datlow AND
                kappl = 'V'.
            DESCRIBE TABLE t_header_a635 LINES ilines.
            IF ilines > max_line.
              MESSAGE s016(es) WITH max_line.
" *****Code Remediation changes S4 2025_S Conversion **begin of change by EJX9007360 2026.06.09 ATC
*           DELETE t_header_a635 INDEX ilines.
            DELETE t_header_a635 INDEX ilines. "#EC CI_NOORDER
" *****Code Remediation changes S4 2025_S Conversion **end of change by EJX9007360 2026.06.09 ATC
            ENDIF.

              INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE t_header_a825
              PACKAGE SIZE pack_size
              FOR ALL ENTRIES IN itab_kschl
              WHERE  kschl EQ itab_kschl-kschl AND
              kschl IN kschl     AND
              vkorg IN l_17     AND
              vkbur IN l_9     AND
              /ccc/incmlvl IN l_10     AND
              /scl/opmarket IN l_22     AND
              katr4 IN l_16     AND
              /scl/carb IN l_23     AND
              /scl/brand IN l_25     AND
              /scl/psize IN l_4     AND
              /scl/ptype IN l_5     AND
              /scl/slun IN l_7     AND
              kfrst IN l_11     AND
             (  ( datab >= datlow  AND  datbi <= dathigh ) OR
                ( datab <= datlow AND datbi >= datlow  ) OR
                ( datab <= dathigh AND datbi >= dathigh )  )  AND
              kappl = 'V'.

            DESCRIBE TABLE t_header_a825 LINES ilines.
            IF ilines > max_line.
              MESSAGE s016(es) WITH max_line.
              DELETE t_header_a825 INDEX ilines.
            ENDIF.
            EXIT.
          ENDSELECT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.                      " EXclusiv

        auth_check-ok = 'X'.
        COLLECT auth_check.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND t_konh.
  ENDLOOP.
  REFRESH auth_check.
  t_konh-kotabnr = 'A824'.
  t_konh-kvewe = 'A'.
  LOOP AT t_header_a824.
* Authority check                                                      *
    READ TABLE auth_check WITH KEY
         kschl  =
         t_header_a824-kschl
         vkorg  =
         t_header_a824-vkorg
   ok = 'X'.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.                  " no authority  checked
* Authority check                                                      *
      CLEAR auth_check.
      MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_header_a824 TO auth_check.
      auth_check-kschl = t_header_a824-kschl.
      auth_check-kvewe = 'A'.
      auth_check-kappl = 'V'.
      auth_check-kotabnr = '824'.

        EXPORTING
          i_vkorg      = auth_check-vkorg
          i_vtweg      = auth_check-vtweg
          i_spart      = auth_check-spart
          i_kschl      = auth_check-kschl
          i_kvewe      = auth_check-kvewe
          i_kappl      = auth_check-kappl
          i_kotabnr    = auth_check-kotabnr
          i_ekorg      = auth_check-ekorg
          i_activity   = '03'    " Display read
        EXCEPTIONS
          no_authority = 1
          OTHERS       = 2.
      IF sy-subrc NE 0.                " no authority
        MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE 'S' NUMBER sy-msgno
            WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4.
        auth_check-ok = ' '.
        COLLECT auth_check.
        CONTINUE.
      ELSE.
        auth_check-ok = 'X'.
        COLLECT auth_check.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
* Append the T_KONH for the accesss in KONP                            *
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_header_a824 TO t_konh.
    APPEND t_konh.

*  authority check für Stammdatenversendung                            *
      AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'B_ALE_MAST'
                ID 'EDI_MES' FIELD p_mestyp.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE e250.
      ELSE.
*  muß der Message-Typ überhaupt versendet werden                      *
        CLEAR idoc_to_send.
        CALL FUNCTION 'ALE_MODEL_DETERMINE_IF_TO_SEND'
          EXPORTING
            message_type           = p_mestyp
            receiving_system       = p_logsys
            validdate              = sy-datum
          IMPORTING
            idoc_must_be_sent      = idoc_to_send
          EXCEPTIONS
            own_system_not_defined = 1
            OTHERS                 = 2.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR idoc_to_send <> 'X'.
          MESSAGE ID 'VJ' TYPE 'E' NUMBER '000'
                  WITH p_mestyp p_logsys.
        ELSE.
* jetzt endlich das IDoc erzeugen                                      *
          CALL FUNCTION 'MASTERIDOC_CREATE_COND_A'
            EXPORTING
              pi_mestyp                 = p_mestyp
              pi_logsys                 = p_logsys
              pi_direkt                 = 'X'
            TABLES
              pit_conditions            = gt_knumh
            EXCEPTIONS
              idoc_could_not_be_created = 1.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            MESSAGE s751.
          ELSE.
            COMMIT WORK.
            MESSAGE s750.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

* Fill Text for KSCHL on Position Level if Requested                   *
      SELECT SINGLE * FROM t681u INTO t681u_tmp
         WHERE kvewe = 'A'
         AND konli = konli_tmp+16(2)
         AND fieldname = 'KSCHL'
         AND ( kotex = '2'
         OR kotex = '3' ).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        MOVE t_pos_a635-kschl TO t_pos_a635-%%%kschl.
        PERFORM text_suche USING 'KSCHL' 'V' 'A'
                        CHANGING   t_pos_a635-%%%kschl
                                   dummy.
        MODIFY t_pos_a635.
        MOVE t_pos_a635-kschl TO kschl_tmp.
        MOVE t_pos_a635-%%%kschl TO tmp_%%%kschl.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      MOVE tmp_%%%kschl TO t_pos_a635-%%%kschl.
      MODIFY t_pos_a635.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

  LOOP AT t_pos_a635.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_pos_a635 TO komg.
* fill the konp                                                        *
    READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY knumh = t_pos_a635-knumh
                               kopos = t_pos_a635-kopos
                           BINARY SEARCH.
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_konp TO konp.
    MOVE t_pos_a635-%kfrst
    TO komg-kfrst.
    MOVE t_pos_a635-%kfrst
    TO konp-kfrst.
* get the text for the each field                                      *
    IF NOT komg-pltyp IS INITIAL.
    ENDIF.
    IF NOT komg-vkorg IS INITIAL.
      PERFORM text_suche USING 'VKORG' 'V' 'A'
                                    CHANGING
                                    t_pos_a635-tvkorg
                                   dummy.

    ENDIF.

      PERFORM text_suche USING 'MATNR' 'V' 'A'

                                    t_pos_a635-tmatnr

  LOOP AT t_pos_a752 WHERE mwsk1 <> space.
    CHECK NOT t_pos_a752 IS INITIAL.
    ADD 1 TO col_pos.
    add_afield mwsk1  t_pos_a752 konp 1 col_pos
                   fieldcat_a752.
    EXIT.
  ENDLOOP.

  IF NOT par_staf IS INITIAL.
    ADD 1 TO col_pos.
    add_afield_dummy stfkz t_pos_a752 konp 1 col_pos
              fieldcat_a752  10  %%stfkz.
    ADD 1 TO col_pos.
    add_afield_dummy kstbm t_pos_a752 konp 1 col_pos
              fieldcat_a752  15  %%sba.
    ADD 1 TO col_pos.
    add_afield_dummy konms t_pos_a752 konp 1 col_pos
              fieldcat_a752  5  %%sun.
  ENDIF.

  ADD 1 TO col_pos.
  add_pos_refcurfield kbetr  t_pos_a752  %%konwa col_pos
                   fieldcat_a752.
  ADD 1 TO col_pos.
  add_afield konwa t_pos_a752 konp 1 col_pos
                   fieldcat_a752.
  ADD 1 TO col_pos.
  add_afield kpein t_pos_a752 konp 1 col_pos
                   fieldcat_a752.
  ADD 1 TO col_pos.
  add_afield kmein t_pos_a752 konp 1 col_pos
                   fieldcat_a752.
  IF NOT par_dat IS INITIAL.
    ADD 1 TO col_pos.
    add_afield datab t_pos_a752 vake 1 col_pos
                     fieldcat_a752.
    ADD 1 TO col_pos.
    add_afield datbi t_pos_a752 vake 1 col_pos
                     fieldcat_a752.
  ENDIF.

  IF NOT par_pos IS INITIAL.
    ADD 1 TO col_pos.
    add_pos_refcurfield mxwrt  t_pos_a752  %%konwa col_pos
                     fieldcat_a752.
    ADD 1 TO col_pos.
    add_pos_refcurfield gkwrt  t_pos_a752  %%konwa col_pos
                     fieldcat_a752.
    ADD 1 TO col_pos.
    add_pos_refcurfield pkwrt  t_pos_a752  %%konwa col_pos
                     fieldcat_a752.
    ADD 1 TO col_pos.
    add_pos_refcurfield fkwrt  t_pos_a752  kwaeh col_pos
                     fieldcat_a752.
    ADD 1 TO col_pos.
    add_pos_refcurfield rswrt  t_pos_a752  kwaeh col_pos
                     fieldcat_a752.
    ADD 1 TO col_pos.
    add_pos_refcurfield komxwrt  t_pos_a752  kwaeh col_pos
                     fieldcat_a752.
    ADD 1 TO col_pos.
    add_afield kwaeh t_pos_a752 konp 1 col_pos
                     fieldcat_a752.
  ENDIF.

*--------------- F O R M        R O U T I N E -------------------------*
FORM callback_status USING  extab TYPE slis_t_extab.

  CALL FUNCTION 'SD_SET_LIST_STATUS'
    EXPORTING
      extab  = ex_fcode
    EXCEPTIONS
      OTHERS = 0.

ENDFORM.                    "CALLBACK_STATUS

*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       FORM CALLBACK_USER_COMMAND                                    **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       ........                                                      **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*  -->  UCOMM                                                         **
*  -->  RS_SELFIELD                                                   **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
FORM callback_user_command USING ucomm LIKE sy-ucomm
                           rs_selfield TYPE slis_selfield.

  DATA: found(1) TYPE c.
  DATA: lt_xvake TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF vakevb WITH HEADER LINE,
        lt_xkonp TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF konpdb WITH HEADER LINE,
        lt_xkonh TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF konhdb,
        lt_ykonp TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF konpdb WITH HEADER LINE,
        lt_ykonh TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF konhdb,
        lt_xstaf TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF condscale,
        lt_xkondat TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF vkondat,
        lt_ykondat TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF vkondat,
        lt_time_vake_db TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF vakedb.
  DATA: lv_counter TYPE i,
        lv_answer(1).

*---- macro defination for the jump in the condition screen            *
  DEFINE jump.
    call function 'SD_JUMP_TO_COND'
      exporting
        knumh         = &1-knumh
        datbi         = &1-%%datbi
        kopos         = &1-kopos
        condition_use = 'A'
        first_screen  = 'A'
        maintain_mode = &2
      exceptions
        others        = 0.
  END-OF-DEFINITION.
  DEFINE jump_to_cond.

*--- call the condition screen                                         *
    read table &1 index rs_selfield-tabindex.
    jump &1 &2.

  END-OF-DEFINITION.                   " JUMP_TO_COND

  DEFINE check_auth.
    call function 'SD_COND_AUTH_CHECK'
      exporting
        i_vkorg      = komg-vkorg
        i_vtweg      = komg-vtweg
        i_spart      = komg-spart
        i_kschl      = auth_check-kschl
        i_kvewe      = auth_check-kvewe
        i_kappl      = auth_check-kappl
        i_kotabnr    = auth_check-kotabnr
        i_ekorg      = auth_check-ekorg
        i_activity   = &1
      exceptions
        no_authority = 1
        others       = 2.
    if sy-subrc ne 0.
      message id sy-msgid type 'E' number sy-msgno
          with sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4.
    endif.
  END-OF-DEFINITION.

  DEFINE delete_cond.
    refresh: lt_xkonp, lt_ykonp, lt_xvake.
    loop at t_pos_&1.
      read table t_konp with key
           knumh = t_pos_&1-knumh
           kopos = 1
           binary search.
      check sy-subrc eq 0 and t_konp-loevm_ko is initial.
      move-corresponding t_konp to lt_ykonp.
      append lt_ykonp.
      lt_xkonp = lt_ykonp.
      lt_xkonp-loevm_ko = 'X'.
      lt_xkonp-updkz = 'U'.
      append lt_xkonp.
      move-corresponding t_pos_&1 to lt_xvake.
      move-corresponding t_pos_&1 to komg.
      perform fill_vakey_from_komg
              in program rv13&1
              using lt_xvake-vakey komg.
      lt_xvake-kvewe = 'A'.
      lt_xvake-kappl = 'V'.
      lt_xvake-kotabnr = &2.
      append lt_xvake.
    endloop.
    describe table lt_xvake lines sy-fdpos.
    if not sy-fdpos is initial.
      add sy-fdpos to lv_counter.
      call function 'RV_KONDITION_SICHERN_V13A'
        exporting
          change_docs_write = 'X'
          use_outbound_call = 'X'
        tables
          db_time           = lt_time_vake_db
          db_xkonh          = lt_xkonh
          db_xkonp          = lt_xkonp
          db_xstaf          = lt_xstaf
          db_ykonh          = lt_ykonh
          db_ykonp          = lt_ykonp
          db_xkondat        = lt_xkondat
          db_ykondat        = lt_ykondat
          db_xvake          = lt_xvake.
    endif.
  END-OF-DEFINITION.

* +   CASE UCOMM.                                                      *
* +     WHEN '&IC1'.                                                   *
  IF ucomm EQ '&IC1'.
* +       CASE RS_SELFIELD-TABNAME.                                    *
    CLEAR found.
  ENDIF.
* +         WHEN  'T_POS_A635'.                                        *
  IF ucomm EQ '&IC1' AND rs_selfield-tabname EQ 'T_POS_A635'.

* transport the conditions                                             *
*  IDOC are defined only for the Usage A and E (Bonus)                 *
* +     WHEN 'TRAN'.                                                   *
  IF ucomm EQ 'TRAN'.
    DATA: p_mestyp LIKE edidc-mestyp VALUE 'COND_A',
          p_logsys LIKE tbdls-logsys VALUE space.
    DATA: BEGIN OF gt_knumh OCCURS 10.
            INCLUDE STRUCTURE vkkacondit.
    DATA: END OF gt_knumh.
    DATA: fields LIKE sval OCCURS 2 WITH HEADER LINE.
    DATA: returncode(1)       TYPE c,
          popup_title(30)     TYPE c,
          idoc_to_send(1)     TYPE c.
* Prepare the data to be send                                          *
    p_mestyp = 'COND_A'.
    EXPORT p_mestyp TO MEMORY ID 'COND_A_MEM'.
* check if the table GT_knumh is filled or not                         *
    READ TABLE gt_knumh INDEX 1.
    IF sy-subrc NE 0.  " not filled
      PERFORM fill_cond_idoc TABLES gt_knumh.
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE gt_knumh INDEX 1.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.  " till yet not any data send
      popup_title = 'Sendeparameter angeben'(103).
      REFRESH fields.
      CLEAR fields.
      fields-tabname    = 'TBDME'.
      fields-fieldname  = 'MESTYP'.
      fields-value      = p_mestyp.        "Vorbesetzung im Popup
      fields-field_obl  = 'X'.             "Muß-Feld
      APPEND fields.
      CLEAR fields.
      fields-tabname    = 'TBDLS'.
      fields-fieldname  = 'LOGSYS'.
      fields-field_obl  = ' '.
      APPEND fields.
* use the standard pop with the report std report Rv130004 for cond.   *
      CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_GET_VALUES_USER_HELP'
        EXPORTING
          popup_title    = popup_title
          programname    = 'RV130004'
          formname       = 'EXAMPLE_EXIT'
          f4_programname = 'RV130004'
          f4_formname    = 'EXAMPLE_F4'
        IMPORTING
          returncode     = returncode
        TABLES
          fields         = fields.

      IF returncode <> space.
        MESSAGE e751.
      ENDIF.

      LOOP AT fields.
        IF fields-tabname   = 'TBDME' AND
           fields-fieldname = 'MESTYP'.
          p_mestyp = fields-value.
        ELSEIF fields-tabname   = 'TBDLS' AND
               fields-fieldname = 'LOGSYS'.
          p_logsys = fields-value.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

*  authority check für Stammdatenversendung                            *
      AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'B_ALE_MAST'
                ID 'EDI_MES' FIELD p_mestyp.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE e250.
      ELSE.
*  muß der Message-Typ überhaupt versendet werden                      *
        CLEAR idoc_to_send.
        CALL FUNCTION 'ALE_MODEL_DETERMINE_IF_TO_SEND'
          EXPORTING
            message_type           = p_mestyp
            receiving_system       = p_logsys
            validdate              = sy-datum
          IMPORTING
            idoc_must_be_sent      = idoc_to_send
          EXCEPTIONS
            own_system_not_defined = 1
            OTHERS                 = 2.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR idoc_to_send <> 'X'.
          MESSAGE ID 'VJ' TYPE 'E' NUMBER '000'
                  WITH p_mestyp p_logsys.
        ELSE.
* jetzt endlich das IDoc erzeugen                                      *
*             SET PF-STATUS 'NONO' OF PROGRAM 'SAPLV130'.              *
          CALL FUNCTION 'RV_CONDITION_GET_CUA_REPO'
            EXPORTING
              pfkey_i = 'NONO'
              title_i = 'R'.
* +              PAR1_I  = KSCHL                                       *
* +              PAR2_I  = T685T-VTEXT                                 *
* +              PAR3_I  = SPACE                                       *
*               PAR4_I  = SPACE.                                       *
          CALL FUNCTION 'RV_CONDITION_SET_CUA_REPO'.
          CALL FUNCTION 'MASTERIDOC_CREATE_COND_A'
            EXPORTING
              pi_mestyp                 = p_mestyp
              pi_logsys                 = p_logsys
              pi_direkt                 = 'X'
            TABLES
              pit_conditions            = gt_knumh
            EXCEPTIONS
              idoc_could_not_be_created = 1.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            MESSAGE s751.
          ELSE.
            COMMIT WORK.
            MESSAGE s750.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
* +   ENDCASE.                                                         *
  ENDIF.                                                    "TRAN
ENDFORM.                    "CALLBACK_USER_COMMAND

    gt_knumh-a_datab = t_pos_a824-datab.
    gt_knumh-datab = t_pos_a824-datab.
    gt_knumh-msgfn  = '004'.

    gt_knumh-kappl  = 'V'.
    gt_knumh-kotabnr = '824'.
    APPEND gt_knumh.
  ENDLOOP.
* Add the entries of the table A825                                    *
  LOOP AT t_pos_a825.
    CHECK NOT t_pos_a825-datbi IS INITIAL.
    CHECK t_pos_a825-kopos EQ 1.
    gt_knumh-a_datbi = t_pos_a825-datbi.
    gt_knumh-datbi = t_pos_a825-datbi.

    gt_knumh-kappl  = 'V'.
    gt_knumh-kotabnr = '825'.
    APPEND gt_knumh.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.                    "FILL_COND_IDOC

FORM event_end_of_first_list.
  DATA:    et_events_line TYPE slis_alv_event.
* event fühlen                                                         *
  CLEAR et_events_rest[].
  CLEAR et_events_rest.
  CLEAR et_events_line.
  et_events_line-name = slis_ev_top_of_page.
  et_events_line-form = 'EVENT_TOP_OF_LIST_REST'.
  APPEND et_events_line TO et_events_rest.

*--- macro defination to call the print_next_list_alv                  *
  DEFINE  print_next_list_of.
    data: tmp_table_&1 like line of header_list_&1.
    read table header_list_&1 into tmp_table_&1
               index sorttab-ltabix.
    perform print_next_list_alv
      tables   tmp_table_&1-table[]  t_pos_&1
      using    fieldcat_&1     it_sort_&1   et_events_rest
               'T_HEADER_&1'    'T_POS_&1'  is_print_axxx.
  END-OF-DEFINITION.

  DATA   oldtabix   LIKE sy-tabix.
  DEFINE  print_next_simple_list_of.
    clear  oldtabix.
    data: tmp_table_&1 like line of header_list_&1.
    data table_&1 like t_pos_&1[] with header line.
    refresh table_&1.
    read table header_list_&1 into tmp_table_&1
               index sorttab-ltabix.
    data: line_&1  like line of header_list_&1-table.
    loop at tmp_table_&1-table into line_&1.
*    DATA TABLE_&1 LIKE T_POS_&1[] WITH HEADER LINE.                   *
      loop at t_pos_&1 where %%%%no = line_&1-%%%%no.
        append t_pos_&1 to table_&1.
      endloop.
    endloop.
    move table_&1[] to pos_list_&1-table[].
    append pos_list_&1.
    splitt_tab_name-kotab = '&1'.
    splitt_tab_name-no = sy-tabix.
    data alo_fieldcat_&1 like line of fieldcat_&1.
    alo_fieldcat_&1-tabname = splitt_tab_name.
    modify fieldcat_&1 from alo_fieldcat_&1
         transporting tabname where tabname ne ' '.
    data alo_sort_&1 like line of it_sort_&1.
    alo_sort_&1-tabname = splitt_tab_name.
    modify it_sort_&1 from alo_sort_&1
         transporting tabname where tabname ne ' '.
    perform print_next_simple_list_alv
      tables  pos_list_&1-table[]
     using    fieldcat_&1     it_sort_&1   et_events_rest
              'T_POS_&1' is_print_axxx.
  END-OF-DEFINITION.

  LOOP AT sorttab.
    CHECK sorttab-out IS INITIAL.
    CHECK sy-tabix > 1.
* set the mark flag                                                    *
    sorttab-out = 'X'.
    MODIFY sorttab TRANSPORTING out.

    CASE sorttab-axxx.
      WHEN 'A635'.
* +      IF SORTTAB-AXXX EQ 'A635'.                                    *

        print_next_simple_list_of a635.

      WHEN 'A636'.

*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       FORM EVENT_TOP_OF_LIST_AXXX                                   **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       ........                                                      **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
FORM event_top_of_list_axxx.

  DATA: dummy.
  DATA: it_list_commentary TYPE slis_t_listheader,
        it_list_commentary_line TYPE slis_listheader.
  DATA: l_titel LIKE dd04v-scrtext_m.

  CLEAR it_list_commentary_line.
  REFRESH it_list_commentary.
  it_list_commentary_line-typ = 'S'.

  DATA sorttab_tabix LIKE sy-tabix VALUE 0.

  sorttab_tabix = 1.
  READ TABLE sorttab INDEX sorttab_tabix.
  sorttab-out = 'X'.
  MODIFY sorttab INDEX 1 TRANSPORTING out.
  MOVE-CORRESPONDING sorttab TO komg.
  CLEAR konp-kschl.
  MOVE-CORRESPONDING sorttab TO konp.


  CALL FUNCTION 'REUSE_ALV_COMMENTARY_WRITE'
    EXPORTING
      it_list_commentary = it_list_commentary
    EXCEPTIONS
      OTHERS             = 1.
ENDFORM.                    "EVENT_TOP_OF_LIST_AXXX


*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       FORM EVENT_TOP_OF_LIST_REST                                   **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       ........                                                      **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
FORM event_top_of_list_rest.

  DATA: dummy.
  DATA: it_list_commentary TYPE slis_t_listheader,
        it_list_commentary_line TYPE slis_listheader.
  DATA: l_titel LIKE dd04v-scrtext_m.

  CLEAR it_list_commentary_line.
  REFRESH it_list_commentary.
  it_list_commentary_line-typ = 'S'.

  DATA sorttab_tabix LIKE sy-tabix VALUE 0.

  LOOP AT sorttab.
    IF sorttab-out = 'X'.
      sorttab_tabix = sy-tabix.
    ELSE.
      EXIT.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
* if nothing is found, then print the last name                        *
  IF sorttab_tabix = 0.
    DESCRIBE TABLE sorttab LINES sorttab_tabix.
  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE sorttab INDEX sorttab_tabix.

  MOVE-CORRESPONDING sorttab TO komg.
  CLEAR konp-kschl.
  MOVE-CORRESPONDING sorttab TO konp.


  CALL FUNCTION 'REUSE_ALV_COMMENTARY_WRITE'
    EXPORTING
      it_list_commentary = it_list_commentary
    EXCEPTIONS
      OTHERS             = 1.
ENDFORM.                    "EVENT_TOP_OF_LIST_REST




DEFINE    get_scale.
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
  if not par_staf is initial.
    read table t_scale with key
       knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
       binary search.
    if sy-subrc eq 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
      if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
        t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
      else.
        write t_konp-konms to t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
      endif.
      case t_konp-stfkz.
        when ' '.
          t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
        when 'A'.
          t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
        when 'B'.
          t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
        when 'D'.
          t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
      endcase.
      while sy-subrc eq 0 and
            t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   and
            t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
        tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
        move-corresponding t_scale to t_pos_axxx.
        if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
          write t_pos_axxx-kstbw currency t_konp-konws
                  to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
        else.
          write t_pos_axxx-kstbm unit t_konp-konms
                  to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
        endif.
        append t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
        clear t_pos_axxx.
        perform get_ref_forcurrper using t_konp-konwa
                 changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
        t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
        add 1 to tmp_tabix_scale.
        read table t_scale index tmp_tabix_scale.
      endwhile.
    else.
      append t_pos_axxx.
    endif.
  else.
    append t_pos_axxx.
  endif.
END-OF-DEFINITION.


*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       FORM GET_LIST_POS_A635                                         *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       get the positikon table for the listviewer                    **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*  --> T_HEADER_AXXX                                     *             *
*  -->  T_POS_AXXX                                                    **
*  -->  T_KONP                                                        **
*  -->  T_SCALE                                                       **
*  -->  PAR_STAF                                                      **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
FORM get_list_pos_a635
               TABLES  t_header_axxx LIKE t_header_a635[]   "Changi
                       t_pos_axxx    LIKE t_pos_a635[]     "Changin
                       t_konp       LIKE t_konp[]         "USING
                       t_scale      LIKE t_scale[]        "USING
               USING   par_staf        TYPE c.

  DATA: tmp_tabix_konp   LIKE sy-tabix.
  DATA: tmp_tabix_scale  LIKE sy-tabix.
  DATA: old_knumh        LIKE konp-knumh.
  DATA: old_kopos        LIKE konp-kopos.
  DATA: lv_error         TYPE xfeld.

  LOOP AT t_header_axxx.
    old_knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
    t_pos_axxx-%kfrst =
    t_header_axxx-kfrst.
    READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY
       knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh
       kopos = 1
       BINARY SEARCH.
    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      DELETE t_header_axxx.
    ELSE.
      IF NOT p_delete IS INITIAL.
        CLEAR lv_error.
        CLEAR komg.
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_header_a635 TO komg.
        MOVE t_konp TO konp.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'PLTYP' 'A' 'A635'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'VKORG' 'A' 'A635'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'MATNR' 'A' 'A635'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'KFRST' 'A' 'A635'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          DELETE t_header_axxx.
          CONTINUE.
        ENDIF.
        CLEAR sy-subrc.
      ENDIF.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *
      WHILE sy-subrc EQ 0 AND
        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
        tmp_tabix_konp = sy-tabix.
*----------- get the Axxx fields                                       *
        IF old_knumh NE t_pos_axxx-knumh.
          MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_header_axxx TO t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
          t_pos_axxx-matnr. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%pltyp =
          t_pos_axxx-pltyp. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          IF t_konp-kopos NE 1.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-datab.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-matnr.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-pltyp.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_konp TO t_pos_axxx.
        PERFORM get_ref_forcurrper
                 USING t_konp-konwa
                 CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        IF t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        ELSE.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          WRITE t_konp-kschl TO t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 BINARY SEARCH.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
        ENDIF.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        IF NOT par_staf IS INITIAL.
          READ TABLE t_scale WITH KEY
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             BINARY SEARCH.
          IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            IF t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            ELSE.
              WRITE t_konp-konms TO t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            ENDIF.
            CASE t_konp-stfkz.
              WHEN ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              WHEN 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              WHEN 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              WHEN 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            ENDCASE.
            WHILE sy-subrc EQ 0 AND
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   AND
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_scale TO t_pos_axxx.
              IF t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                WRITE t_pos_axxx-kstbw CURRENCY t_konp-konws
                        TO t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              ELSE.
                WRITE t_pos_axxx-kstbm UNIT t_konp-konms
                        TO t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              ENDIF.
              READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 BINARY SEARCH.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              APPEND t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
              t_header_axxx-matnr.
              t_pos_axxx-%%pltyp =
              t_header_axxx-pltyp.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              PERFORM get_ref_forcurrper USING t_konp-konwa
                       CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_scale.
              READ TABLE t_scale INDEX tmp_tabix_scale.
            ENDWHILE.
          ELSE.
            APPEND t_pos_axxx.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          APPEND t_pos_axxx.
        ENDIF.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_konp.
        CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
        READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
      ENDWHILE.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A635

              t_header_axxx-/scl/psize.

              t_header_axxx-/scl/ptype.

                       CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *

          ELSE.
            APPEND t_pos_axxx.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          APPEND t_pos_axxx.
        ENDIF.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_konp.
        CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
        READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
      ENDWHILE.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A656

*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       FORM GET_LIST_POS_A658                                         *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       get the positikon table for the listviewer                    **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*  --> T_HEADER_AXXX                                     *             *
*  -->  T_POS_AXXX                                                    **
*  -->  T_KONP                                                        **
*  -->  T_SCALE                                                       **
*  -->  PAR_STAF                                                      **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
FORM get_list_pos_a658
               TABLES  t_header_axxx LIKE t_header_a658[]   "Changi
                       t_pos_axxx    LIKE t_pos_a658[]     "Changin
                       t_konp       LIKE t_konp[]         "USING
                       t_scale      LIKE t_scale[]        "USING
               USING   par_staf        TYPE c.

  DATA: tmp_tabix_konp   LIKE sy-tabix.
  DATA: tmp_tabix_scale  LIKE sy-tabix.
  DATA: old_knumh        LIKE konp-knumh.
  DATA: old_kopos        LIKE konp-kopos.
  DATA: lv_error         TYPE xfeld.

  LOOP AT t_header_axxx.
    old_knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
    t_pos_axxx-%kfrst =
    t_header_axxx-kfrst.
    READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY
       knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh
       kopos = 1
       BINARY SEARCH.
    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      DELETE t_header_axxx.
    ELSE.
      IF NOT p_delete IS INITIAL.
        CLEAR lv_error.
        CLEAR komg.
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_header_a658 TO komg.
        MOVE t_konp TO konp.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'PLTYP' 'A' 'A658'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'VKORG' 'A' 'A658'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/BRAND' 'A' 'A658'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/PSIZE' 'A' 'A658'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/PTYPE' 'A' 'A658'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/SLUN' 'A' 'A658'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'KFRST' 'A' 'A658'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          DELETE t_header_axxx.
          CONTINUE.
        ENDIF.
        CLEAR sy-subrc.
      ENDIF.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *
      WHILE sy-subrc EQ 0 AND
        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
        tmp_tabix_konp = sy-tabix.
*----------- get the Axxx fields                                       *
        IF old_knumh NE t_pos_axxx-knumh.
          MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_header_axxx TO t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%pltyp =
          t_pos_axxx-pltyp. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          IF t_konp-kopos NE 1.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-datab.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-pltyp.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_konp TO t_pos_axxx.
        PERFORM get_ref_forcurrper
                 USING t_konp-konwa
                 CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        IF t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        ELSE.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          WRITE t_konp-kschl TO t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 BINARY SEARCH.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
        ENDIF.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        IF NOT par_staf IS INITIAL.
          READ TABLE t_scale WITH KEY
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             BINARY SEARCH.
          IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            IF t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            ELSE.
              WRITE t_konp-konms TO t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            ENDIF.
            CASE t_konp-stfkz.
              WHEN ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              WHEN 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              WHEN 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              WHEN 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            ENDCASE.
            WHILE sy-subrc EQ 0 AND
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   AND
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_scale TO t_pos_axxx.
              IF t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                WRITE t_pos_axxx-kstbw CURRENCY t_konp-konws
                        TO t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              ELSE.
                WRITE t_pos_axxx-kstbm UNIT t_konp-konms
                        TO t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              ENDIF.
              READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 BINARY SEARCH.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              APPEND t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/psize.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/ptype.
              t_pos_axxx-%%pltyp =
              t_header_axxx-pltyp.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/slun.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/brand.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              PERFORM get_ref_forcurrper USING t_konp-konwa
                       CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_scale.
              READ TABLE t_scale INDEX tmp_tabix_scale.
            ENDWHILE.
          ELSE.
            APPEND t_pos_axxx.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          APPEND t_pos_axxx.
        ENDIF.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_konp.
        CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
        READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
      ENDWHILE.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A658

              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_scale.
              READ TABLE t_scale INDEX tmp_tabix_scale.
            ENDWHILE.
          ELSE.
            APPEND t_pos_axxx.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          APPEND t_pos_axxx.
        ENDIF.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_konp.
        CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
        READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
      ENDWHILE.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A663

*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       FORM GET_LIST_POS_A750                                         *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       get the positikon table for the listviewer                    **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*  --> T_HEADER_AXXX                                     *             *
*  -->  T_POS_AXXX                                                    **
*  -->  T_KONP                                                        **
*  -->  T_SCALE                                                       **
*  -->  PAR_STAF                                                      **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
FORM get_list_pos_a750
               TABLES  t_header_axxx LIKE t_header_a750[]   "Changi
                       t_pos_axxx    LIKE t_pos_a750[]     "Changin
                       t_konp       LIKE t_konp[]         "USING
                       t_scale      LIKE t_scale[]        "USING
               USING   par_staf        TYPE c.

  DATA: tmp_tabix_konp   LIKE sy-tabix.
  DATA: tmp_tabix_scale  LIKE sy-tabix.
  DATA: old_knumh        LIKE konp-knumh.
  DATA: old_kopos        LIKE konp-kopos.
  DATA: lv_error         TYPE xfeld.

  LOOP AT t_header_axxx.
    old_knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
    t_pos_axxx-%kfrst =
    t_header_axxx-kfrst.
    READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY
       knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh
       kopos = 1
       BINARY SEARCH.
    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      DELETE t_header_axxx.
    ELSE.
      IF NOT p_delete IS INITIAL.
        CLEAR lv_error.
        CLEAR komg.
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_header_a750 TO komg.
        MOVE t_konp TO konp.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'PLTYP' 'A' 'A750'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'VKORG' 'A' 'A750'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/CARB' 'A' 'A750'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/BRAND' 'A' 'A750'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/PSIZE' 'A' 'A750'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/PTYPE' 'A' 'A750'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/SLUN' 'A' 'A750'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'KFRST' 'A' 'A750'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          DELETE t_header_axxx.
          CONTINUE.
        ENDIF.
        CLEAR sy-subrc.
      ENDIF.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *
      WHILE sy-subrc EQ 0 AND
        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
        tmp_tabix_konp = sy-tabix.
*----------- get the Axxx fields                                       *
        IF old_knumh NE t_pos_axxx-knumh.
          MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_header_axxx TO t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%pltyp =
          t_pos_axxx-pltyp. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          IF t_konp-kopos NE 1.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-datab.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-pltyp.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_konp TO t_pos_axxx.
        PERFORM get_ref_forcurrper
                 USING t_konp-konwa
                 CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        IF t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        ELSE.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          WRITE t_konp-kschl TO t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 BINARY SEARCH.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
        ENDIF.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        IF NOT par_staf IS INITIAL.
          READ TABLE t_scale WITH KEY
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             BINARY SEARCH.
          IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            IF t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            ELSE.
              WRITE t_konp-konms TO t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            ENDIF.
            CASE t_konp-stfkz.
              WHEN ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              WHEN 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              WHEN 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              WHEN 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            ENDCASE.
            WHILE sy-subrc EQ 0 AND
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   AND
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_scale TO t_pos_axxx.
              IF t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                WRITE t_pos_axxx-kstbw CURRENCY t_konp-konws
                        TO t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              ELSE.
                WRITE t_pos_axxx-kstbm UNIT t_konp-konms
                        TO t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              ENDIF.
              READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 BINARY SEARCH.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              APPEND t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/psize.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/ptype.
              t_pos_axxx-%%pltyp =
              t_header_axxx-pltyp.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/slun.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/carb.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/brand.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              PERFORM get_ref_forcurrper USING t_konp-konwa
                       CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_scale.
              READ TABLE t_scale INDEX tmp_tabix_scale.
            ENDWHILE.
          ELSE.
            APPEND t_pos_axxx.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          APPEND t_pos_axxx.
        ENDIF.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_konp.
        CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
        READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
      ENDWHILE.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A750

            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-vkbur.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-katr4.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_konp TO t_pos_axxx.
        PERFORM get_ref_forcurrper
                 USING t_konp-konwa
                 CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        IF t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        ELSE.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          WRITE t_konp-kschl TO t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 BINARY SEARCH.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
        ENDIF.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        IF NOT par_staf IS INITIAL.
          READ TABLE t_scale WITH KEY
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             BINARY SEARCH.
          IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            IF t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            ELSE.
              WRITE t_konp-konms TO t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            ENDIF.
            CASE t_konp-stfkz.
              WHEN ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              WHEN 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              WHEN 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              WHEN 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            ENDCASE.
            WHILE sy-subrc EQ 0 AND
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   AND
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_scale TO t_pos_axxx.
              IF t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                WRITE t_pos_axxx-kstbw CURRENCY t_konp-konws
                        TO t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              ELSE.
                WRITE t_pos_axxx-kstbm UNIT t_konp-konms
                        TO t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              ENDIF.
              READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 BINARY SEARCH.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              APPEND t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/psize.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/ptype.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/slun.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
              t_header_axxx-vkbur.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
              t_header_axxx-katr4.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/carb.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/brand.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              PERFORM get_ref_forcurrper USING t_konp-konwa
                       CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_scale.
              READ TABLE t_scale INDEX tmp_tabix_scale.
            ENDWHILE.
          ELSE.
            APPEND t_pos_axxx.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          APPEND t_pos_axxx.
        ENDIF.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_konp.
        CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
        READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
      ENDWHILE.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A752

*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       FORM GET_LIST_POS_A753                                         *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       get the positikon table for the listviewer                    **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*  --> T_HEADER_AXXX                                     *             *
*  -->  T_POS_AXXX                                                    **
*  -->  T_KONP                                                        **
*  -->  T_SCALE                                                       **
*  -->  PAR_STAF                                                      **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
FORM get_list_pos_a753
               TABLES  t_header_axxx LIKE t_header_a753[]   "Changi
                       t_pos_axxx    LIKE t_pos_a753[]     "Changin
                       t_konp       LIKE t_konp[]         "USING
                       t_scale      LIKE t_scale[]        "USING
               USING   par_staf        TYPE c.

  DATA: tmp_tabix_konp   LIKE sy-tabix.
  DATA: tmp_tabix_scale  LIKE sy-tabix.
  DATA: old_knumh        LIKE konp-knumh.
  DATA: old_kopos        LIKE konp-kopos.
  DATA: lv_error         TYPE xfeld.

  LOOP AT t_header_axxx.
    old_knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
    t_pos_axxx-%kfrst =
    t_header_axxx-kfrst.
    READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY
       knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh
       kopos = 1
       BINARY SEARCH.
    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      DELETE t_header_axxx.
    ELSE.
      IF NOT p_delete IS INITIAL.
        CLEAR lv_error.
        CLEAR komg.
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_header_a753 TO komg.
        MOVE t_konp TO konp.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'VKORG' 'A' 'A753'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'VKBUR' 'A' 'A753'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'KATR4' 'A' 'A753'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'MATNR' 'A' 'A753'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'KFRST' 'A' 'A753'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          DELETE t_header_axxx.
          CONTINUE.
        ENDIF.
        CLEAR sy-subrc.
      ENDIF.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *
      WHILE sy-subrc EQ 0 AND
        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
        tmp_tabix_konp = sy-tabix.
*----------- get the Axxx fields                                       *
        IF old_knumh NE t_pos_axxx-knumh.
          MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_header_axxx TO t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
          t_pos_axxx-matnr. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
          t_pos_axxx-vkbur. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
          t_pos_axxx-katr4. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          IF t_konp-kopos NE 1.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-datab.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-matnr.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-vkbur.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-katr4.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_konp TO t_pos_axxx.
        PERFORM get_ref_forcurrper
                 USING t_konp-konwa
                 CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        IF t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        ELSE.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          WRITE t_konp-kschl TO t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 BINARY SEARCH.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
        ENDIF.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        IF NOT par_staf IS INITIAL.
          READ TABLE t_scale WITH KEY
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             BINARY SEARCH.
          IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            IF t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            ELSE.
              WRITE t_konp-konms TO t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            ENDIF.
            CASE t_konp-stfkz.
              WHEN ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              WHEN 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              WHEN 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              WHEN 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            ENDCASE.
            WHILE sy-subrc EQ 0 AND
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   AND
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.

              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              APPEND t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
              t_header_axxx-matnr.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
              t_header_axxx-vkbur.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
              t_header_axxx-katr4.

              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_scale.
              READ TABLE t_scale INDEX tmp_tabix_scale.
            ENDWHILE.
          ELSE.
            APPEND t_pos_axxx.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          APPEND t_pos_axxx.
        ENDIF.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_konp.
