          t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
          t_pos_axxx-vkbur. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opchannel =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/opchannel. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/ccc/geolvl4 =
          t_pos_axxx-/ccc/geolvl4. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
          t_pos_axxx-katr4. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opmarket =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/opmarket. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          IF t_konp-kopos NE 1.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-datab.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-matnr.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-vkbur.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/opchannel.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/ccc/geolvl4.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-katr4.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/opmarket.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_konp TO t_pos_axxx.
        PERFORM get_ref_forcurrper
                 USING t_konp-konwa
                 CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        IF t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        ELSE.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          WRITE t_konp-kschl TO t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 BINARY SEARCH.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
        ENDIF.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        IF NOT par_staf IS INITIAL.
          READ TABLE t_scale WITH KEY
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             BINARY SEARCH.
          IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            IF t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            ELSE.
              WRITE t_konp-konms TO t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            ENDIF.
            CASE t_konp-stfkz.
              WHEN ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              WHEN 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              WHEN 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              WHEN 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            ENDCASE.
            WHILE sy-subrc EQ 0 AND
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   AND
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_scale TO t_pos_axxx.
              IF t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                WRITE t_pos_axxx-kstbw CURRENCY t_konp-konws
                        TO t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              ELSE.
                WRITE t_pos_axxx-kstbm UNIT t_konp-konms
                        TO t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              ENDIF.
              READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 BINARY SEARCH.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              APPEND t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
              t_header_axxx-matnr.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
              t_header_axxx-vkbur.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opchannel =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/opchannel.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/ccc/geolvl4 =
              t_header_axxx-/ccc/geolvl4.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
              t_header_axxx-katr4.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opmarket =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/opmarket.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              PERFORM get_ref_forcurrper USING t_konp-konwa
                       CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_scale.
              READ TABLE t_scale INDEX tmp_tabix_scale.
            ENDWHILE.
          ELSE.
            APPEND t_pos_axxx.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          APPEND t_pos_axxx.
        ENDIF.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_konp.
        CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
        READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
      ENDWHILE.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A804

*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       FORM GET_LIST_POS_A805                                         *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       get the positikon table for the listviewer                    **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*  --> T_HEADER_AXXX                                     *             *
*  -->  T_POS_AXXX                                                    **
*  -->  T_KONP                                                        **
*  -->  T_SCALE                                                       **
*  -->  PAR_STAF                                                      **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
FORM get_list_pos_a805
               TABLES  t_header_axxx LIKE t_header_a805[]   "Changi
                       t_pos_axxx    LIKE t_pos_a805[]     "Changin
                       t_konp       LIKE t_konp[]         "USING
                       t_scale      LIKE t_scale[]        "USING
               USING   par_staf        TYPE c.

  DATA: tmp_tabix_konp   LIKE sy-tabix.
  DATA: tmp_tabix_scale  LIKE sy-tabix.
  DATA: old_knumh        LIKE konp-knumh.
  DATA: old_kopos        LIKE konp-kopos.
  DATA: lv_error         TYPE xfeld.

  LOOP AT t_header_axxx.
    old_knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
    t_pos_axxx-%kfrst =
    t_header_axxx-kfrst.
    READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY
       knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh
       kopos = 1
       BINARY SEARCH.
    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      DELETE t_header_axxx.
    ELSE.
      IF NOT p_delete IS INITIAL.
        CLEAR lv_error.
        CLEAR komg.
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_header_a805 TO komg.
        MOVE t_konp TO konp.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'VKORG' 'A' 'A805'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'VKBUR' 'A' 'A805'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/CCC/GEOLVL4' 'A' 'A805'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/OPCHANNEL' 'A' 'A805'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/OPMARKET' 'A' 'A805'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'KATR4' 'A' 'A805'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/CARB' 'A' 'A805'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/BRAND' 'A' 'A805'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/PTYPE' 'A' 'A805'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/PSIZE' 'A' 'A805'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/SLUN' 'A' 'A805'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'KFRST' 'A' 'A805'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          DELETE t_header_axxx.
          CONTINUE.
        ENDIF.
        CLEAR sy-subrc.
      ENDIF.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *
      WHILE sy-subrc EQ 0 AND
        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
        tmp_tabix_konp = sy-tabix.
*----------- get the Axxx fields                                       *
        IF old_knumh NE t_pos_axxx-knumh.
          MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_header_axxx TO t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
          t_pos_axxx-vkbur. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opchannel =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/opchannel. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/ccc/geolvl4 =
          t_pos_axxx-/ccc/geolvl4. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
          t_pos_axxx-katr4. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opmarket =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/opmarket. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          IF t_konp-kopos NE 1.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-datab.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-vkbur.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/opchannel.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/ccc/geolvl4.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-katr4.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/opmarket.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_konp TO t_pos_axxx.
        PERFORM get_ref_forcurrper
                 USING t_konp-konwa
                 CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        IF t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        ELSE.

          WRITE t_konp-kschl TO t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 BINARY SEARCH.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
        ENDIF.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        IF NOT par_staf IS INITIAL.
          READ TABLE t_scale WITH KEY
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             BINARY SEARCH.
          IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            IF t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            ELSE.
              WRITE t_konp-konms TO t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            ENDIF.
            CASE t_konp-stfkz.
              WHEN ' '.

              WHEN 'A'.

            ENDCASE.

              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/slun.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
              t_header_axxx-vkbur.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opchannel =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/opchannel.

              t_header_axxx-/ccc/geolvl4.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
              t_header_axxx-katr4.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opmarket =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/opmarket.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/carb.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =

              t_header_axxx-kfrst.

                       CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.

              CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
              t_header_axxx-matnr.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
              t_header_axxx-vkbur.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opchannel =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/opchannel.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/ccc/geolvl3 =
              t_header_axxx-/ccc/geolvl3.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
              t_header_axxx-katr4.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opmarket =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/opmarket.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              PERFORM get_ref_forcurrper USING t_konp-konwa
                       CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_scale.
              READ TABLE t_scale INDEX tmp_tabix_scale.
            ENDWHILE.
          ELSE.
            APPEND t_pos_axxx.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          APPEND t_pos_axxx.
        ENDIF.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_konp.
        CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
        READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
      ENDWHILE.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A806

*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       FORM GET_LIST_POS_A807                                         *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       get the positikon table for the listviewer                    **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*  --> T_HEADER_AXXX                                     *             *
*  -->  T_POS_AXXX                                                    **
*  -->  T_KONP                                                        **
*  -->  T_SCALE                                                       **
*  -->  PAR_STAF                                                      **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
FORM get_list_pos_a807
               TABLES  t_header_axxx LIKE t_header_a807[]   "Changi
                       t_pos_axxx    LIKE t_pos_a807[]     "Changin
                       t_konp       LIKE t_konp[]         "USING
                       t_scale      LIKE t_scale[]        "USING
               USING   par_staf        TYPE c.

  DATA: tmp_tabix_konp   LIKE sy-tabix.
  DATA: tmp_tabix_scale  LIKE sy-tabix.
  DATA: old_knumh        LIKE konp-knumh.
  DATA: old_kopos        LIKE konp-kopos.
  DATA: lv_error         TYPE xfeld.

  LOOP AT t_header_axxx.
    old_knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
    t_pos_axxx-%kfrst =
    t_header_axxx-kfrst.
    READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY
       knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh
       kopos = 1
       BINARY SEARCH.
    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      DELETE t_header_axxx.
    ELSE.
      IF NOT p_delete IS INITIAL.
        CLEAR lv_error.
        CLEAR komg.
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_header_a807 TO komg.
        MOVE t_konp TO konp.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'VKORG' 'A' 'A807'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'VKBUR' 'A' 'A807'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/CCC/GEOLVL3' 'A' 'A807'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/OPCHANNEL' 'A' 'A807'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/OPMARKET' 'A' 'A807'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'KATR4' 'A' 'A807'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/CARB' 'A' 'A807'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/BRAND' 'A' 'A807'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/PTYPE' 'A' 'A807'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/PSIZE' 'A' 'A807'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/SLUN' 'A' 'A807'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'KFRST' 'A' 'A807'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          DELETE t_header_axxx.
          CONTINUE.
        ENDIF.
        CLEAR sy-subrc.
      ENDIF.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *
      WHILE sy-subrc EQ 0 AND
        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
        tmp_tabix_konp = sy-tabix.
*----------- get the Axxx fields                                       *
        IF old_knumh NE t_pos_axxx-knumh.
          MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_header_axxx TO t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
          t_pos_axxx-vkbur. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opchannel =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/opchannel. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/ccc/geolvl3 =
          t_pos_axxx-/ccc/geolvl3. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
          t_pos_axxx-katr4. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opmarket =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/opmarket. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          IF t_konp-kopos NE 1.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-datab.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-vkbur.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/opchannel.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/ccc/geolvl3.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-katr4.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/opmarket.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_konp TO t_pos_axxx.
        PERFORM get_ref_forcurrper
                 USING t_konp-konwa
                 CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        IF t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        ELSE.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          WRITE t_konp-kschl TO t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 BINARY SEARCH.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
        ENDIF.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        IF NOT par_staf IS INITIAL.
          READ TABLE t_scale WITH KEY
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             BINARY SEARCH.
          IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            IF t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            ELSE.
              WRITE t_konp-konms TO t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            ENDIF.
            CASE t_konp-stfkz.
              WHEN ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              WHEN 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              WHEN 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              WHEN 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            ENDCASE.
            WHILE sy-subrc EQ 0 AND
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   AND
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_scale TO t_pos_axxx.
              IF t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                WRITE t_pos_axxx-kstbw CURRENCY t_konp-konws
                        TO t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              ELSE.
                WRITE t_pos_axxx-kstbm UNIT t_konp-konms
                        TO t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              ENDIF.
              READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 BINARY SEARCH.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              APPEND t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/psize.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/ptype.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/slun.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
              t_header_axxx-vkbur.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opchannel =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/opchannel.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/ccc/geolvl3 =
              t_header_axxx-/ccc/geolvl3.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
              t_header_axxx-katr4.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opmarket =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/opmarket.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/carb.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/brand.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              PERFORM get_ref_forcurrper USING t_konp-konwa
                       CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_scale.
              READ TABLE t_scale INDEX tmp_tabix_scale.
            ENDWHILE.
          ELSE.
            APPEND t_pos_axxx.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          APPEND t_pos_axxx.
        ENDIF.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_konp.
        CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
        READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
      ENDWHILE.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A807

                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'KATR4' 'A' 'A809'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/CARB' 'A' 'A809'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/BRAND' 'A' 'A809'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/PTYPE' 'A' 'A809'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/PSIZE' 'A' 'A809'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/SLUN' 'A' 'A809'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'KFRST' 'A' 'A809'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          DELETE t_header_axxx.
          CONTINUE.
        ENDIF.
        CLEAR sy-subrc.
      ENDIF.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *
      WHILE sy-subrc EQ 0 AND
        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
        tmp_tabix_konp = sy-tabix.
*----------- get the Axxx fields                                       *
        IF old_knumh NE t_pos_axxx-knumh.
          MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_header_axxx TO t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
          t_pos_axxx-vkbur. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opchannel =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/opchannel. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
          t_pos_axxx-katr4. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/ccc/geolvl2 =
          t_pos_axxx-/ccc/geolvl2. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opmarket =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/opmarket. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          IF t_konp-kopos NE 1.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-datab.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-vkbur.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/opchannel.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-katr4.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/ccc/geolvl2.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/opmarket.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_konp TO t_pos_axxx.
        PERFORM get_ref_forcurrper
                 USING t_konp-konwa
                 CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        IF t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        ELSE.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          WRITE t_konp-kschl TO t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 BINARY SEARCH.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
        ENDIF.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        IF NOT par_staf IS INITIAL.
          READ TABLE t_scale WITH KEY
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             BINARY SEARCH.
          IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            IF t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            ELSE.
              WRITE t_konp-konms TO t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            ENDIF.
            CASE t_konp-stfkz.
              WHEN ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              WHEN 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              WHEN 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              WHEN 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            ENDCASE.
            WHILE sy-subrc EQ 0 AND
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   AND
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_scale TO t_pos_axxx.
              IF t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                WRITE t_pos_axxx-kstbw CURRENCY t_konp-konws
                        TO t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              ELSE.
                WRITE t_pos_axxx-kstbm UNIT t_konp-konms
                        TO t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              ENDIF.
              READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 BINARY SEARCH.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              APPEND t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/psize.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/ptype.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/slun.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
              t_header_axxx-vkbur.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opchannel =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/opchannel.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
              t_header_axxx-katr4.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/ccc/geolvl2 =
              t_header_axxx-/ccc/geolvl2.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opmarket =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/opmarket.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/carb.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/brand.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              PERFORM get_ref_forcurrper USING t_konp-konwa
                       CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_scale.
              READ TABLE t_scale INDEX tmp_tabix_scale.
            ENDWHILE.
          ELSE.
            APPEND t_pos_axxx.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          APPEND t_pos_axxx.
        ENDIF.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_konp.
        CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
        READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
      ENDWHILE.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A809

*       get the positikon table for the listviewer                    **

*  -->  T_KONP                                                        **
*  -->  T_SCALE                                                       **
*  -->  PAR_STAF                                                      **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
FORM get_list_pos_a810
               TABLES  t_header_axxx LIKE t_header_a810[]   "Changi
                       t_pos_axxx    LIKE t_pos_a810[]     "Changin
                       t_konp       LIKE t_konp[]         "USING
                       t_scale      LIKE t_scale[]        "USING
               USING   par_staf        TYPE c.

  DATA: tmp_tabix_konp   LIKE sy-tabix.
  DATA: tmp_tabix_scale  LIKE sy-tabix.
  DATA: old_knumh        LIKE konp-knumh.
  DATA: old_kopos        LIKE konp-kopos.
  DATA: lv_error         TYPE xfeld.

  LOOP AT t_header_axxx.
    old_knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
    t_pos_axxx-%kfrst =
    t_header_axxx-kfrst.
    READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY
       knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh
       kopos = 1
       BINARY SEARCH.
    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      DELETE t_header_axxx.
    ELSE.
      IF NOT p_delete IS INITIAL.
        CLEAR lv_error.
        CLEAR komg.
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_header_a810 TO komg.
        MOVE t_konp TO konp.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'VKORG' 'A' 'A810'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'VKBUR' 'A' 'A810'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/CCC/GEOLVL1' 'A' 'A810'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/OPCHANNEL' 'A' 'A810'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/OPMARKET' 'A' 'A810'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'KATR4' 'A' 'A810'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'MATNR' 'A' 'A810'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'KFRST' 'A' 'A810'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          DELETE t_header_axxx.

        ENDIF.

      ENDIF.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *
      WHILE sy-subrc EQ 0 AND
        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
        tmp_tabix_konp = sy-tabix.
*----------- get the Axxx fields                                       *
        IF old_knumh NE t_pos_axxx-knumh.
          MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_header_axxx TO t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
          t_pos_axxx-matnr. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
          t_pos_axxx-vkbur. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opchannel =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/opchannel. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
          t_pos_axxx-katr4. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/ccc/geolvl1 =
          t_pos_axxx-/ccc/geolvl1. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opmarket =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/opmarket. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *

            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-datab.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-matnr.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-vkbur.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/opchannel.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-katr4.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/ccc/geolvl1.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/opmarket.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.

          kopos = 1 BINARY SEARCH.

*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *

                       CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.

            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-vkbur.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/opchannel.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-katr4.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/ccc/geolvl1.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/opmarket.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_konp TO t_pos_axxx.
        PERFORM get_ref_forcurrper
                 USING t_konp-konwa
                 CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        IF t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        ELSE.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          WRITE t_konp-kschl TO t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 BINARY SEARCH.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
        ENDIF.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        IF NOT par_staf IS INITIAL.
          READ TABLE t_scale WITH KEY
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             BINARY SEARCH.
          IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            IF t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            ELSE.
              WRITE t_konp-konms TO t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            ENDIF.
            CASE t_konp-stfkz.
              WHEN ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              WHEN 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              WHEN 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              WHEN 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            ENDCASE.
            WHILE sy-subrc EQ 0 AND
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   AND
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_scale TO t_pos_axxx.
              IF t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                WRITE t_pos_axxx-kstbw CURRENCY t_konp-konws
                        TO t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              ELSE.
                WRITE t_pos_axxx-kstbm UNIT t_konp-konms
                        TO t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              ENDIF.
              READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 BINARY SEARCH.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              APPEND t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/psize.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/ptype.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/slun.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
              t_header_axxx-vkbur.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opchannel =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/opchannel.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
              t_header_axxx-katr4.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/ccc/geolvl1 =
              t_header_axxx-/ccc/geolvl1.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opmarket =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/opmarket.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/carb.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/brand.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              PERFORM get_ref_forcurrper USING t_konp-konwa
                       CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_scale.
              READ TABLE t_scale INDEX tmp_tabix_scale.
            ENDWHILE.
          ELSE.
            APPEND t_pos_axxx.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          APPEND t_pos_axxx.
        ENDIF.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_konp.
        CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
        READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
      ENDWHILE.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A811

*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       FORM GET_LIST_POS_A812                                         *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       get the positikon table for the listviewer                    **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*  --> T_HEADER_AXXX                                     *             *
*  -->  T_POS_AXXX                                                    **
*  -->  T_KONP                                                        **
*  -->  T_SCALE                                                       **
*  -->  PAR_STAF                                                      **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
FORM get_list_pos_a812
               TABLES  t_header_axxx LIKE t_header_a812[]   "Changi
                       t_pos_axxx    LIKE t_pos_a812[]     "Changin
                       t_konp       LIKE t_konp[]         "USING
                       t_scale      LIKE t_scale[]        "USING
               USING   par_staf        TYPE c.

  DATA: tmp_tabix_konp   LIKE sy-tabix.
  DATA: tmp_tabix_scale  LIKE sy-tabix.
  DATA: old_knumh        LIKE konp-knumh.
  DATA: old_kopos        LIKE konp-kopos.
  DATA: lv_error         TYPE xfeld.

  LOOP AT t_header_axxx.
    old_knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
    t_pos_axxx-%kfrst =
    t_header_axxx-kfrst.
    READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY
       knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh
       kopos = 1
       BINARY SEARCH.
    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      DELETE t_header_axxx.
    ELSE.
      IF NOT p_delete IS INITIAL.
        CLEAR lv_error.
        CLEAR komg.
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_header_a812 TO komg.
        MOVE t_konp TO konp.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'VKORG' 'A' 'A812'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'VKBUR' 'A' 'A812'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'KUNRG' 'A' 'A812'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/TRADENAME' 'A' 'A812'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'MATNR' 'A' 'A812'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'KFRST' 'A' 'A812'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          DELETE t_header_axxx.
          CONTINUE.
        ENDIF.
        CLEAR sy-subrc.
      ENDIF.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *
      WHILE sy-subrc EQ 0 AND
        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
        tmp_tabix_konp = sy-tabix.
*----------- get the Axxx fields                                       *
        IF old_knumh NE t_pos_axxx-knumh.
          MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_header_axxx TO t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%kunrg =
          t_pos_axxx-kunrg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
          t_pos_axxx-matnr. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/tradename =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/tradename. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
          t_pos_axxx-vkbur. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          IF t_konp-kopos NE 1.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-datab.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-kunrg.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-matnr.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/tradename.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-vkbur.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_konp TO t_pos_axxx.
        PERFORM get_ref_forcurrper
                 USING t_konp-konwa
                 CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        IF t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        ELSE.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          WRITE t_konp-kschl TO t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 BINARY SEARCH.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
        ENDIF.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        IF NOT par_staf IS INITIAL.
          READ TABLE t_scale WITH KEY
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             BINARY SEARCH.
          IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            IF t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            ELSE.
              WRITE t_konp-konms TO t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            ENDIF.
            CASE t_konp-stfkz.
              WHEN ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              WHEN 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              WHEN 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              WHEN 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            ENDCASE.
            WHILE sy-subrc EQ 0 AND
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   AND
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.

                        TO t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              ELSE.
                WRITE t_pos_axxx-kstbm UNIT t_konp-konms
                        TO t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              ENDIF.
              READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 BINARY SEARCH.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              APPEND t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%kunrg =
              t_header_axxx-kunrg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
              t_header_axxx-matnr.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/tradename =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/tradename.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
              t_header_axxx-vkbur.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.

              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              PERFORM get_ref_forcurrper USING t_konp-konwa
                       CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *

          ELSE.

          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          APPEND t_pos_axxx.
        ENDIF.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *

    t_pos_axxx-%kfrst =
    t_header_axxx-kfrst.
    READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY
       knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh
       kopos = 1
       BINARY SEARCH.
    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      DELETE t_header_axxx.
    ELSE.
      IF NOT p_delete IS INITIAL.
        CLEAR lv_error.
        CLEAR komg.
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_header_a814 TO komg.
        MOVE t_konp TO konp.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'VKORG' 'A' 'A814'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'VKBUR' 'A' 'A814'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'KUKLA' 'A' 'A814'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'KATR7' 'A' 'A814'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'KATR4' 'A' 'A814'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'MATNR' 'A' 'A814'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'KFRST' 'A' 'A814'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          DELETE t_header_axxx.
          CONTINUE.
        ENDIF.
        CLEAR sy-subrc.
      ENDIF.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *
      WHILE sy-subrc EQ 0 AND
        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
        tmp_tabix_konp = sy-tabix.
*----------- get the Axxx fields                                       *
        IF old_knumh NE t_pos_axxx-knumh.
          MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_header_axxx TO t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
          t_pos_axxx-matnr. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
          t_pos_axxx-vkbur. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
          t_pos_axxx-katr4. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%kukla =
          t_pos_axxx-kukla. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%katr7 =
          t_pos_axxx-katr7. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          IF t_konp-kopos NE 1.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-datab.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-matnr.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-vkbur.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-katr4.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-kukla.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-katr7.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_konp TO t_pos_axxx.
        PERFORM get_ref_forcurrper
                 USING t_konp-konwa
                 CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        IF t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        ELSE.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          WRITE t_konp-kschl TO t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 BINARY SEARCH.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
        ENDIF.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        IF NOT par_staf IS INITIAL.
          READ TABLE t_scale WITH KEY
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             BINARY SEARCH.
          IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            IF t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            ELSE.
              WRITE t_konp-konms TO t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            ENDIF.
            CASE t_konp-stfkz.
              WHEN ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              WHEN 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              WHEN 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              WHEN 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            ENDCASE.
            WHILE sy-subrc EQ 0 AND
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   AND
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_scale TO t_pos_axxx.
              IF t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                WRITE t_pos_axxx-kstbw CURRENCY t_konp-konws
                        TO t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              ELSE.
                WRITE t_pos_axxx-kstbm UNIT t_konp-konms
                        TO t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              ENDIF.
              READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 BINARY SEARCH.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              APPEND t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
              t_header_axxx-matnr.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
              t_header_axxx-vkbur.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
              t_header_axxx-katr4.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%kukla =
              t_header_axxx-kukla.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr7 =
              t_header_axxx-katr7.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              PERFORM get_ref_forcurrper USING t_konp-konwa
                       CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_scale.
              READ TABLE t_scale INDEX tmp_tabix_scale.
            ENDWHILE.
          ELSE.
            APPEND t_pos_axxx.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          APPEND t_pos_axxx.
        ENDIF.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_konp.
        CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
        READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
      ENDWHILE.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A814

                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              WHEN 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              WHEN 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            ENDCASE.
            WHILE sy-subrc EQ 0 AND
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   AND
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_scale TO t_pos_axxx.
              IF t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                WRITE t_pos_axxx-kstbw CURRENCY t_konp-konws
                        TO t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              ELSE.
                WRITE t_pos_axxx-kstbm UNIT t_konp-konms
                        TO t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              ENDIF.
              READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 BINARY SEARCH.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              APPEND t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
              t_header_axxx-matnr.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
              t_header_axxx-vkbur.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opchannel =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/opchannel.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
              t_header_axxx-katr4.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%kukla =
              t_header_axxx-kukla.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              PERFORM get_ref_forcurrper USING t_konp-konwa
                       CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_scale.
              READ TABLE t_scale INDEX tmp_tabix_scale.
            ENDWHILE.
          ELSE.
            APPEND t_pos_axxx.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          APPEND t_pos_axxx.
        ENDIF.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_konp.
        CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
        READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
      ENDWHILE.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A816

*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       FORM GET_LIST_POS_A817                                         *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       get the positikon table for the listviewer                    **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*  --> T_HEADER_AXXX                                     *             *
*  -->  T_POS_AXXX                                                    **
*  -->  T_KONP                                                        **
*  -->  T_SCALE                                                       **
*  -->  PAR_STAF                                                      **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
FORM get_list_pos_a817
               TABLES  t_header_axxx LIKE t_header_a817[]   "Changi
                       t_pos_axxx    LIKE t_pos_a817[]     "Changin
                       t_konp       LIKE t_konp[]         "USING
                       t_scale      LIKE t_scale[]        "USING
               USING   par_staf        TYPE c.

  DATA: tmp_tabix_konp   LIKE sy-tabix.
  DATA: tmp_tabix_scale  LIKE sy-tabix.
  DATA: old_knumh        LIKE konp-knumh.
  DATA: old_kopos        LIKE konp-kopos.
  DATA: lv_error         TYPE xfeld.

  LOOP AT t_header_axxx.
    old_knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
    t_pos_axxx-%kfrst =
    t_header_axxx-kfrst.
    READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY
       knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh
       kopos = 1
       BINARY SEARCH.
    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      DELETE t_header_axxx.
    ELSE.
      IF NOT p_delete IS INITIAL.
        CLEAR lv_error.
        CLEAR komg.
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_header_a817 TO komg.
        MOVE t_konp TO konp.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'VKORG' 'A' 'A817'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'VKBUR' 'A' 'A817'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'KUKLA' 'A' 'A817'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/OPCHANNEL' 'A' 'A817'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'KATR4' 'A' 'A817'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/CARB' 'A' 'A817'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/BRAND' 'A' 'A817'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/PSIZE' 'A' 'A817'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/PTYPE' 'A' 'A817'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/SLUN' 'A' 'A817'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'KFRST' 'A' 'A817'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          DELETE t_header_axxx.
          CONTINUE.
        ENDIF.
        CLEAR sy-subrc.
      ENDIF.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *
      WHILE sy-subrc EQ 0 AND
        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
        tmp_tabix_konp = sy-tabix.
*----------- get the Axxx fields                                       *
        IF old_knumh NE t_pos_axxx-knumh.
          MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_header_axxx TO t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
          t_pos_axxx-vkbur. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opchannel =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/opchannel. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
          t_pos_axxx-katr4. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%kukla =
          t_pos_axxx-kukla. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          IF t_konp-kopos NE 1.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-datab.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-vkbur.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/opchannel.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-katr4.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-kukla.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_konp TO t_pos_axxx.
        PERFORM get_ref_forcurrper
                 USING t_konp-konwa
                 CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        IF t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        ELSE.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          WRITE t_konp-kschl TO t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 BINARY SEARCH.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
        ENDIF.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        IF NOT par_staf IS INITIAL.
          READ TABLE t_scale WITH KEY
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             BINARY SEARCH.
          IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            IF t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            ELSE.
              WRITE t_konp-konms TO t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            ENDIF.
            CASE t_konp-stfkz.
              WHEN ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              WHEN 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              WHEN 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              WHEN 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            ENDCASE.
            WHILE sy-subrc EQ 0 AND
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   AND
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_scale TO t_pos_axxx.
              IF t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                WRITE t_pos_axxx-kstbw CURRENCY t_konp-konws
                        TO t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              ELSE.
                WRITE t_pos_axxx-kstbm UNIT t_konp-konms
                        TO t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              ENDIF.
              READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 BINARY SEARCH.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              APPEND t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/psize.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/ptype.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/slun.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
              t_header_axxx-vkbur.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opchannel =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/opchannel.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
              t_header_axxx-katr4.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%kukla =
              t_header_axxx-kukla.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/carb.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/brand.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              PERFORM get_ref_forcurrper USING t_konp-konwa
                       CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_scale.
              READ TABLE t_scale INDEX tmp_tabix_scale.
            ENDWHILE.
          ELSE.
            APPEND t_pos_axxx.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          APPEND t_pos_axxx.
        ENDIF.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_konp.
        CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
        READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
      ENDWHILE.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A817

          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/CARB' 'A' 'A819'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/BRAND' 'A' 'A819'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/PSIZE' 'A' 'A819'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/PTYPE' 'A' 'A819'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING '/SCL/SLUN' 'A' 'A819'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'KFRST' 'A' 'A819'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          DELETE t_header_axxx.
          CONTINUE.
        ENDIF.
        CLEAR sy-subrc.
      ENDIF.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *
      WHILE sy-subrc EQ 0 AND
        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
        tmp_tabix_konp = sy-tabix.
*----------- get the Axxx fields                                       *
        IF old_knumh NE t_pos_axxx-knumh.
          MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_header_axxx TO t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
          t_pos_axxx-vkbur. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%kukla =
          t_pos_axxx-kukla. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opmarket =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/opmarket. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          IF t_konp-kopos NE 1.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-datab.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-vkbur.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-kukla.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/opmarket.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand.
            CLEAR t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_konp TO t_pos_axxx.
        PERFORM get_ref_forcurrper
                 USING t_konp-konwa
                 CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        IF t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        ELSE.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          WRITE t_konp-kschl TO t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 BINARY SEARCH.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
        ENDIF.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        IF NOT par_staf IS INITIAL.
          READ TABLE t_scale WITH KEY
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             BINARY SEARCH.
          IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            IF t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            ELSE.
              WRITE t_konp-konms TO t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            ENDIF.
            CASE t_konp-stfkz.
              WHEN ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              WHEN 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              WHEN 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              WHEN 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            ENDCASE.
            WHILE sy-subrc EQ 0 AND
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   AND
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_scale TO t_pos_axxx.
              IF t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                WRITE t_pos_axxx-kstbw CURRENCY t_konp-konws
                        TO t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              ELSE.
                WRITE t_pos_axxx-kstbm UNIT t_konp-konms
                        TO t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              ENDIF.
              READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 BINARY SEARCH.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              APPEND t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/psize.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/ptype.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/slun.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
              t_header_axxx-vkbur.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%kukla =
              t_header_axxx-kukla.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opmarket =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/opmarket.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/carb.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/brand.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              PERFORM get_ref_forcurrper USING t_konp-konwa
                       CHANGING t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_scale.
              READ TABLE t_scale INDEX tmp_tabix_scale.
            ENDWHILE.
          ELSE.
            APPEND t_pos_axxx.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          APPEND t_pos_axxx.
        ENDIF.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        ADD 1 TO tmp_tabix_konp.
        CLEAR t_pos_axxx.
        READ TABLE t_konp INDEX tmp_tabix_konp.
      ENDWHILE.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A819

*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       FORM GET_LIST_POS_A820                                         *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       get the positikon table for the listviewer                    **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*  --> T_HEADER_AXXX                                     *             *
*  -->  T_POS_AXXX                                                    **
*  -->  T_KONP                                                        **
*  -->  T_SCALE                                                       **
*  -->  PAR_STAF                                                      **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
FORM get_list_pos_a820
               TABLES  t_header_axxx LIKE t_header_a820[]   "Changi
                       t_pos_axxx    LIKE t_pos_a820[]     "Changin
                       t_konp       LIKE t_konp[]         "USING
                       t_scale      LIKE t_scale[]        "USING
               USING   par_staf        TYPE c.

  DATA: tmp_tabix_konp   LIKE sy-tabix.
  DATA: tmp_tabix_scale  LIKE sy-tabix.
  DATA: old_knumh        LIKE konp-knumh.
  DATA: old_kopos        LIKE konp-kopos.
  DATA: lv_error         TYPE xfeld.

  LOOP AT t_header_axxx.
    old_knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
    t_pos_axxx-%kfrst =
    t_header_axxx-kfrst.
    READ TABLE t_konp WITH KEY
       knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh
       kopos = 1
       BINARY SEARCH.
    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      DELETE t_header_axxx.
    ELSE.
      IF NOT p_delete IS INITIAL.
        CLEAR lv_error.
        CLEAR komg.
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING t_header_a820 TO komg.
        MOVE t_konp TO konp.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'VKORG' 'A' 'A820'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'VKBUR' 'A' 'A820'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.

                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM field_check USING 'MATNR' 'A' 'A820'
                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_error IS INITIAL.

                  CHANGING lv_error.
        ENDIF.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
